Edited by Vartan Karapetian and Marie Tomb with the Armenian Arts Council, it gathers paintings, archives and correspondence. A panel discussion features Ara H. Merjian, Vartan Karapetian, Marie Tomb, Silvia Burini, Hrag Vartanian and Tamar Marie Boyadjian.
https://armenopole.com/american-universi: The American University of Armenia marks its 35th anniversary with a gala bringing together alumni, supporters, and friends from across the Armenian diaspora. The event celebrates AUA's achievements and honors the extraordinary individuals who helped establish the university. A festive evening championing AUA's continued growth and impact.
https://armenopole.com/gayane.html: Tavigh Dance Troupe performs Aram Khachaturian's Gayane ballet under the artistic direction of Luiza Khachatryan.
https://armenopole.com/armenian-karaoke-: The Armenian Cultural Association of America NJ Chapter hosts an Armenian Karaoke Night with a festive, communal atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/armenchik-life-co: Armenian pop star Armenchik launches his European tour with a concert in Strasbourg. The show promises beloved hits, new songs, and a warm atmosphere for the long-awaited reunion with his fans.
https://armenopole.com/la-cuisine-des-ar: Corinne and Richard Zarzavatdjian present their book "La cuisine des Arméniens" with a foreword by Pascal Ory at a signing session at Librairie de l'Atelier. The work explores 70 emblematic recipes across the global Armenian diaspora, blending travelogue and cookbook.
https://armenopole.com/gurdjieff-the-mas: The MUPAC Museum in Colorno hosts the fifth edition of "Free Spirit" featuring the concert-event "Gurdjieff: The Master of Dance". The Ensemble de la Paix, directed by Flavio Spotti, performs music by Gurdjieff and Thomas de Hartmann, accompanied by sacred movements and dances choreographed by Marco Bendoni and Chen Su Ping, in memory of Alfreda D'Ubaldo.
https://armenopole.com/zulal-harvest-and: Zulal, meaning "clear water," is an a cappella trio that transforms Armenia's village folk melodies into arrangements that pay tribute to the music's ancient roots while allowing it new possibilities. The trio celebrates the trials and joys of old Armenian village life, from the echoes of loss to the enduring vibrations of celebration.
https://armenopole.com/y0dbrabb.html: The Armenian Theatre Company presents Samuel Beckett's 'Waiting for Godot,' translated and directed by Armenian artists. This seminal twentieth‑century 'tragi‑comedy' uses constant humour to help audiences gain a deeper understanding of the human interactions that shape everyday life.
https://armenopole.com/the-fools-dinner-: In celebration of the 100th anniversary of the Constantinople Armenian Relief Society, join us for a theatrical performance by Artashat Amo Kharazyan State Drama Theater of Armenia.
https://armenopole.com/conference-sur-la: The National Council of Western Armenia, the National Association of Armenian Veterans and Sympathizers, the Association of French Veterans and Resistants of Armenian origin, the UFAC, and the delegate for patriotic associations and duty of memory invite you to a conference on the Légion d’Orient and the liberation of Cilicia, themed around the Légion d’Orient and the Maghreb Sharpshooters. The event will follow protocol.
https://armenopole.com/anouche.html: Musical piece "Anouche" by Hovhannes Toumanian. By students of Arevi Chogher school and dance groups Ara, Anahit and Ani (Valencia). Music: Armen Tigranyan. Sung by Lussiné Levoni. Choreography: Armen Tchiloyan. Artistic director: Marina Hovhannisyan.
https://armenopole.com/95e-anniversaire-: The Armenian Apostolic Cathedral of the Holy Translators in Marseille marks its 95th consecration anniversary. A solemn Divine Liturgy will be celebrated by Archbishop Datev Hagopian, Primate of the Diocese of Romania, with Archbishop Krikor Khachatryan present. The Sahak-Mesrop Choir, conducted by Garik Kiurkchian, will provide the liturgical music, followed by a reception at the cultural centre.
https://armenopole.com/heritage-day-dedi: Heritage Day Dedicated to Armenian National Heroes. Dinner and dance with the Haigazounner Band, singer Sevag Haroutunian, and a cultural program. Exhibition of artist Meruzhan Khachatryan in collaboration with Hamazkayin. Sunday features a requiem, lecture presentation, cultural program, and coffee and sweets reception.
https://armenopole.com/carmen-switzerlan: The Geneva Opera presents Georges Bizet's Carmen starring mezzo-soprano Nora Sourouzian in the title role, alongside Louis Zaitoun as Don José and Karine Mkrtchyan as Micaëla. The Orchestre Concertus de Genève, Ensemble Vocal Orphée, and a children's choir perform under the baton of Mathieu Schweyer.
https://armenopole.com/gnwlmqyb.html: The 14th edition of TROCADANCE, a contemporary art fair based on auction-style barter, opens at Galerie Marseille 3013. Virginie Anouch Kechmanian presents her cyanotype "Reconstitution de la Perle au Soleil" from her Révolution d'une poétesse cycle. Festive vernissage, 53 artists, and creative exchange proposals await visitors.
https://armenopole.com/hrak-folk-group-e: The Armenian Church in Utrecht hosts a year-end gathering with the Hrak Folk Group. A warm, communal atmosphere invites guests to bring savory or sweet dishes to share. Santa Claus will bring gifts for the children.
https://armenopole.com/new-year-s-eve-ga: A sparkling dinner and dance to end 2026 and welcome 2027. Watch the live city fireworks from the unique Frenchs Forest hall. Eat, dance, and party until the countdown to 2027.
https://armenopole.com/building-memories: John and June Mangassarian present "Building Memories in Armenia" at the cathedral, sharing their humanitarian work in Armenia's Ararat region with the Paros Foundation.
https://armenopole.com/h2lqpj7v.html: The Armenian Theatre Company presents Samuel Beckett's "Waiting for Godot" performed in Armenian. Directed by Aramazd Stepanian, translated by Ashot Jrbashyan. Starring Ashot Tadevossian, Shant Nazarian, Aris Baghoomian, Arthur Donahue, and Nare Barseghyan. A seminal 20th-century tragi-comedy.
https://armenopole.com/armenian-assembly: The Armenian Assembly of America hosts "Hye Toast Orange County" in California. Executive Director Bryan Ardouny, visiting from Washington, D.C., will share organizational updates, advocacy news, and ways to get involved. A reception with food and hosted beverages will be provided by Armenian-owned Bayside Restaurant.
https://armenopole.com/celebration-conce: The Armenian Church of Pennsylvania hosts a concert celebrating its new organ. Proceeds benefit the church fund, followed by a reception.
https://armenopole.com/sound-of-her-root: The "Sound of Her Roots" concert features music from Armenia, Bulgaria, and Taiwan. Soprano Knarik Nerkararyan, marimbist Sylvie Zakarian, violist Jing-Huey Wei, and pianist Erica Lee perform works by Komitas Vartabet and contemporary composers. The event is sponsored by Menotomy Chamber Series and an ACAC Grant.
https://armenopole.com/o93mjzvg.html: Artashat Amo Kharazyan State Drama Theater of Armenia performs "The Fools Dinner" in New York marking the 100th anniversary of the Constantinople Armenian Relief Society. The play is in Armenian.
C.A.R.S. (Constantinople Armenian Relief Society) presents Francis Veber's "The Fool's Dinner" performed by Armenia's Artashat State Drama Theater, celebrating the organization's 100th anniversary.
https://armenopole.com/pop-up-store-sard: Armenian club Sardarapat F.C., founded in 2021 with Antoine Griezmann as a shareholder, hosts a pop-up store in Paris. The new 26/27 kits and the lifestyle collection made in Armenia will be on display.
https://armenopole.com/annual-bazaar-foo: The annual bazaar features a selection of homemade Armenian dishes to enjoy on site or take home. The friendly event invites guests to share a lunch in a warm atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/c15ccxt0.html: The Armenian comedy “Harsnatsun Americayits kam Nor Tarva Kino 2” receives its exclusive London screening at the Courthouse Hotel London. Spotlight Armenia organizes the event for a warm community evening of laughter and cinema.
https://armenopole.com/knocked-conscious: Knocked Conscious returns to Riverside with their biggest sketch comedy show yet, blending old favourites and fresh material. The quartet — Mungo Russell, Gayaneh Lara, Henrie Allen and Calum Maclean — delivers razor-sharp humour praised by critics.
https://armenopole.com/rarpi-alto.html: Armenian group Rarpi Alto performs its first show in Brazil, celebrating 62 years of UGAB Brazil. A festive musical evening at a venue with covered parking.
https://armenopole.com/madagh-solemne-mi: The Isaac Bakchellian Alumni Commission organises a solemn mass and traditional Madagh in Buenos Aires. The event combines liturgical worship with the communal Armenian ritual meal in a spirit of solidarity and remembrance.
